desc: Analyze problem constraints and requirements (min cost, lex smallest, groups >= 3).
Identify DP state as (min_cost, best_string) for prefix i.
Determine that O(n^2) states with O(26) cost calculation is the viable approach despite high constant factor.
Implement the DP solution with precomputed prefix frequency array.
For each segment, compute the cost for each character using the incremental method for F(c) in O(26) time.
Store dp[i] as (min_cost, best_string) and update accordingly.
